role: external oracle for wall_resolution with shapes away from the cell's centre: a circle and an ellipse moved across the cell's edge and corner and a block moved across the corner (written as the four rectangles the cell's edges cut it into), whose reference is the centred structure's 3D finite-element solve read at the moved samples, and a T of two rectangles with no x mirror at theta 20 deg, p; the pre-registered criteria of the widened table are asserted against them

references.build: FEniCS (dolfin) 2019.1.0, gmsh 4.15.2, PETSc/petsc4py 3.26.1, MUMPS 5.8.2 (conda-forge), one thread, out of core

modified.description: used through its public Python API; the package itself was not changed

references.settings: Maxwell3DPeriodic on symmetry-reduced cells: at phi 0 the whole period in x (Bloch periodic) and half of it in y (y mirrors perfect magnetic walls for p), half the height split into parts even and odd in z (two solves); at normal incidence a quarter of the cell (x mirrors perfect electric, y mirrors perfect magnetic walls). Second-order edge (Nedelec) elements, 400 nm of air and 900 nm of perfectly matched layer above and below. R and T by projecting the periodic part of the scattered field on each diffraction order over an air slab. Relative residuals of the direct solves 6.9e-13 to 2.2e-12. A moved shape is the centred structure moved, so its R and T are the centred structure's and its field at a sample r is the centred field at r - d (folded into the cell) times exp(i kx dx) with the Bloch phase of the folding; the centred structure's finer level was solved again with the same mesh rule to read the field there. Its R differs from the stored level's by 4.4e-6 (circle), 7.6e-10 (ellipse) and less than 1e-11 (circle in the 400 x 300 cell, block); the rebuilt circle and ellipse meshes differ from the first ones by 23 and 2 of about 80000 cells. The stored phasors are in gyptis's time convention, the conjugate of Wavebit's; the consumer maps them as sign * conj(E), sign -1 for p. Before measuring, the T's metal volume in the mesh was checked against the analytic one (to 1e-14)
references.discretization: tetrahedral meshes graded toward the walls and edges, two levels per structure (coarser/finer: circle oz 42600/79280 cells, its field from a rebuilt finer level of 79257; ellipse oz 43551/82373, rebuilt 82371; circle in the 400 x 300 cell nz 19082/37746; block oz 50313/104197; T oz 52877/112836), the finer with 0.25 to 0.73 million complex unknowns per solve and a smallest edge of about 1.4 nm; the product side is a Fourier truncation of the same cell

generator.command: python fem_sym.py <case> <level> with the mesh rule v2: the T at levels 0 and 1; the centred circle, ellipse, circle in the 400 x 300 cell and block at level 1 again with SHIFT_GRID set to the moves; then python make_golden_d.py, which takes R and T of the newest records (the centred structures' stored levels for the moved shapes) and the finer level's plane fields reduced to their in-plane components in single precision

cost.note: the finer levels only: four centred structures solved again (the circle's run read both moves) and the T at p; the machine shared its CPU with other work, so the time is not a cost measurement

cells.shapes: C1ap_m1, C1ap_m2: a circle of radius 100 nm centred at (196, 0) and (196, 187) nm; C1ep_m: an ellipse with semi-axes 130 nm along x and 80 nm along y centred at (-146, 130); C1cp_m: the circle centred at (60, 110) in the 400 x 300 cell; R1p_m: a 200 x 200 nm block centred at (146, 130), written as the rectangles x 46..200 and -200..-154 by y 30..200 and -200..-170; A1T_o20p: the rectangles x -120..0, y -100..100 and x 0..80, y -50..50; coordinates from the cell's centre
cells.shape_epsilon: -20+1.5j (Wavebit's convention, loss a positive imaginary part; the runs take its conjugate)

incidence.theta_deg: 0 for C1cp_m, 20 otherwise; phi 0 (plane of incidence xz)
incidence.source: a plane wave from the top

values.R, T: total reflectance and transmittance on the finer mesh level (level 1); for a moved shape the centred structure's
values.R_coarse, T_coarse: the same on the coarser level (level 0)
values.E_<case>: in-plane (Ex, Ey) on each patterned layer's mid-plane, E[plane, j, i, component] at (x[i], y[j]); complex64; gyptis's convention, normalised so the incident wave has phase 0 at the stack's top and x = 0
values.depth_<case>: each plane's depth below the stack's top, top layer first

inputs.mesh_rule: v2 of 2026-11-22: PML 40 nm and air 20 nm elements at every level, refinement at the true edges and on the shapes' walls, top and bottom faces; the two levels differ only in the wall and edge sizes

outcomes.reference_self_check: u_F, the relative R change between the two levels, is 2.0e-04 to 2.0e-03 (above 1e-3, which the criteria call weak, for R1p_m and A1T_o20p); it is stored with the values
outcomes.failed_or_discarded: none of these six; two more cases measured with them (the T at s and two bars of unequal widths) did not meet the criteria and are not stored
